tagline: FOUNDING CFO  ·  BUILD FINANCE FROM SCRATCH  ·  CONTROLS, AUDIT & FORM 990  ·  GRANTS & COMPLIANCE  ·  AI-NATIVE FINANCE
profile: Builder CFO who stands up finance, compliance, and operating infrastructure rather than inheriting it. Designs accounting systems, budgets, forecasts, cash management, internal controls, and a reliable month-end close; owns audits, Form 990s, and grant reporting as an IRS-registered preparer with an active PTIN. Runs a lean, outsourced model as a fractional CFO, selecting and managing payroll, audit, insurance, and benefits partners while staying close to the ledger, and has set up retirement plans, insurance, and payroll for new organizations. Built accounting and governance infrastructure for an international NGO serving children in Haiti and managed restricted grants and funder reporting across a $80M portfolio. Partners with CEOs and Boards, including Finance and Audit Committees, on resource allocation and risk. Builds AI-native workflows (SkyNet, in daily use). MBA.

bullets.text: Lead financial planning, budgeting, treasury, liquidity management, and cash-flow forecasting for client organizations across nonprofit, private, education, and public-sector settings.
Run lean, outsourced-model finance for client organizations: payroll, AP, AR, vendor payments, bank reconciliations, month-end close, and board- and funder-ready financial statements.
Compile Form 990 returns for multiple nonprofits and prepare business and individual tax filings, including state and local returns; IRS-registered preparer with an active PTIN.
Lead annual audit coordination and readiness testing for workforce development, healthcare, and smaller 501(c)(3) organizations.
Direct audit readiness and external audit processes; ensure GAAP and Uniform Guidance compliance; design internal controls and fund-accounting frameworks.
Built and piloted SkyNet, an AI-supported workflow for research, document preparation, and engagement tracking with evidence validation and cost controls, now in full daily use.

jobs.title: Vice President, Business Development & Social Ventures

bullets.text: Held full P&L accountability for an $80M portfolio; led financial and operational oversight of a 140-person, multi-program division.
Managed multiple restricted program budgets with monthly reconciliation and quarterly performance tracking; monitored restricted and unrestricted cash flow against grant terms.
Partnered with the CEO and Board, including the Finance and Audit Committees, on planning, risk, resource allocation, and sustainability.
Reversed a $1M annual operating deficit and delivered a 13% operating surplus through cost restructuring, financial controls, and revenue optimization.
Negotiated and structured $10M+ in new government, institutional, and corporate contracts.
Partnered with the CEO and Board on long-range planning, risk management, and organizational growth strategy.
Created and administered employee retirement plans, including at Alluel Logistics and for Maroon Strategist clients.
Directed financial controls, billing, and compliance for NYCHA and NYC Department of Homeless Services contracts.
Implemented a redesigned ERP-based warehouse management system, improving processing efficiency 60% and data visibility.
Renegotiated vendor and logistics agreements, reducing costs 35% and improving margins.
Built accounting, governance, and operational infrastructure for an international NGO serving children in Haiti.
Served as financial architect for a $200M national banking-development initiative, supporting capital planning and financial structuring.
Developed operational and performance-improvement strategies for $50M+ organizations and major brands.
Stood up landlord, insurance, utility, and vendor contracts and operations across multiple locations.
Built HR, payroll, benefits, and training infrastructure for a team that grew from 4 to 60 full-time employees.
Founded and scaled a multi-location business from a $5K investment to a $1M enterprise; delivered 33% YoY revenue growth and an 11% margin improvement.
